repos.summary_zh: 本项目全面开源收录了中国小学、初中、高中及大学的完整PDF教材，旨在打破信息壁垒，促进义务教育普及，消除地区教育贫困，并为海外华人子女提供便捷的国内基础教育资源获取渠道，助力知识共享。
repos.summary_en: This project open-sources a comprehensive collection of Chinese primary, middle, high school, and university PDF textbooks. It aims to break information barriers, promote educational equality, combat resource hoarding, and help overseas Chinese children easily access domestic textbooks to foster global learning and cultural connection.
